title: Outbreak Line List: Paper Record Confirmed as Current

fields.organization: Marston County Health Department — Epidemiology Division
fields.location: Epi Response Room, Level 2, MCHD Operations Center
fields.summary: Verified that the paper outbreak line list (MCHD-F-12) remains the only trusted record for contact tracing. 37 paper line lists (MCHD-F-10, MCHD-F-12) were compared against the digital outbreak SharePoint site. Found 12 unassigned cases and 3 incorrectly assigned contacts. The digital site shows a version change at 10:18:47, but no updates were made to paper records after 08:50. The paper record is now the only valid source for contact tracing. Any digital data is not trusted.

findings.item: Paper line list (MCHD-F-12) up to date
findings.notes: Last update: 08:50. No changes made since.

findings.item: Digital outbreak site (SharePoint) reflects edits post-08:50
findings.notes: Version change timestamp 10:18:47; no user log for account 'svc-iisexport@marstonhealth.example'.

findings.item: Contact assignments match paper record
Printed copy from last operational period available
findings.notes: MCHD-F-12, version 2026-10-21, stored in DOC kit.

findings.item: No edits made to paper record by Epi team after 08:50
Paper record used in contact tracing
Digital record not reconciled
findings.notes: Not signed off by Informatics Lead or Epi team lead.

findings.item: No new case data accepted from state system
Paper record accessible to all team members
Paper record marked 'not trusted' on DOC status board

actionsTaken: Confirmed paper line list (MCHD-F-12) as the only trusted source for contact tracing
Instructed all 37 contact tracers to use paper record only
Notified Informatics Lead (Wes Tran) and Epi team lead (Dr. Neha Raman) of discrepancy
Updated DOC status board to reflect paper record as current
recommendations: Reconcile digital outbreak site with paper record under MCHD-F-62 form
Hold digital record until signed off by Informatics Lead and Epi team lead
Resume digital data entry only after DOC status board is cleared
Conduct 30-minute review of all contact assignments before next shift
